headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 29, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a dominant 8-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Grant Taylor earning the win. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates edged the Philadelphia Phillies 11-7, with Brandon Marsh leading the Phillies' offense. The Detroit Tigers also won, taking down the New York Yankees 7-3 behind Casey Mize's strong performance.

Several players are dealing with injuries, including Rob Refsnyder, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners due to right knee inflammation. The Baltimore Orioles have also placed Keegan Akin on the 15-day injured list with left elbow discomfort. Other teams have made roster moves, including the Chicago Cubs, who have placed Matt Shaw and Ethan Roberts on the injured list.

The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired in a trade with the San Francisco Giants for cash. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Hayden Juenger from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 11-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 11-7. Brandon Marsh led the Phillies' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits and 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Casey Mize earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs. Amed Rosario led the Tigers' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Francisco Lindor leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Mariners Place Refsnyder on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners DH Rob Refsnyder has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right knee inflammation, effective retroactive to June 27, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mariners Acquire Buddy Kennedy in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners have bolstered their roster with the addition of first baseman Buddy Kennedy, acquired in a trade with the San Francisco Giants for cash. Kennedy joins the Mariners in a move that brings new depth to the team's lineup.
